### Description

A clear description of what went wrong.

### Steps to reproduce

A minimal, self-contained Go program or test that reproduces the problem.

```go
// ...
```

If the failure involves a handshake against a specific server, include the
cipher suite and, where possible, a packet capture or the wire-debug output.

### Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen.

### Actual behaviour

What actually happened, including the full error message and any stack trace.
